endpoints.screen: Invite team member (business-owner app, Team tab "+")
endpoints.description: Post-publish equivalent of business-setup.json#invite-team-member (onboarding's Team invite step), but collects the fuller field set that step never asked for: name, commission split, and working days. At least one of email/phone is required. An invitation IS the team roster record — there's no separate 'member' entity — so this returns the same shape list-my-invitations/get-business-profile-style team lists would use. Roles (2026-10-22): role 'staff' takes appointments (commission on their own services); 'front_desk' runs the desk only (commissionPercent null, not bookable). frontDeskAccess: staff who also run the desk (one person, two modes in the app). Only the owner changes these.

notes: 2026-09-26 (BK-02): members carry staffId, which is null while the invitation is pending and set once accepted. It's the same id as the business profile's staff[].staffId, and it's the id bookings, availability and earnings use. Editing commission/working days still goes through PATCH /team/members/{invitationId}; the server keeps the staff record in sync. Only accepted members (non-null staffId) are bookable.
GET /me/businesses: each workplace also has frontDeskAccess and modes (['staff'] | ['front_desk'] | ['staff','front_desk']) for the app's mode switch.
